_comment: Set "split": "not-split" on any repository that still holds a private method or another company's material beside this company's own; the kit then refuses to clone it. Maps stable names to the repositories this workspace may show. It holds credential REFERENCES (env:NAME), never a token, password or key. Change 'state' to 'active' when a phase is unlocked, then run `aios workspace sync`.
